text:
tess (Finance): Flagging a batch: 8 invoices for NimbusCo are showing wrong totals and one customer got charged twice for the same period.
devin (Billing Eng): Any invoice IDs? sample PDF?
tess (Finance): INV-2024-2210, INV-2024-2210-dup, INV-2024-2215... The PDF for INV-2024-2210 total reads $5,120.00 but ledger lines sum to $4,600.00. Looks like VAT was applied twice on the 'reserved_gpu' line. Raw line dump below:
```
line_items:
 - sku: reserved_gpu_hours
   qty: 200
   unit_cents: 1800
   subtotal_cents: 360000
 - sku: data_transfer
   qty: 5
   unit_cents: 2000
   subtotal_cents: 10000
taxes:
 - name: VAT
   cents: 46000
 - name: VAT (duplicate?)
   cents: 46000
```
ops-bot: Alert: invoice-generator emitted exception at ts=2145680987: `DecimalException: quantize` then `Retrying render (attempt 3)`.
devin (Billing Eng): DecimalException usually from mixing floats/ints in tax calc. The duplicate VAT line and duplicate invoice suffix suggest idempotency key wasn't honored after retry. Could be race between tax service callback and invoice finalizer.
ana (Revenue Ops): NimbusCo reached out about being billed twice. They want confirmation before they dispute charges.
raj (Support): I've messaged NimbusCo: "We're on it, won't deduct until we confirm. You won't be double-billed." 
tess (Finance): We need a rollback plan for the duplicate charge and a corrective invoice showing corrected tax lines. Also audit trail for which process wrote the duplicate tax line.
devin (Billing Eng): Immediate mitigation: pause tax webhook consumers and set invoice-generator to idempotent-mode only. I'll push a patch to explicitly dedupe tax entries by tax code.
audit-bot: Note recorded: tax-webhook paused by devin at ts=2145681105.
devin (Billing Eng): Patch deployed at ts=2145681220. Running regen for affected invoices. I'll include checksum of tax payloads in logs.
ops-bot: Regen job started for batch=invoice-regen-2145681 at ts=2145681300.
devin (Billing Eng): Regen results: success 6/8, fail 2/8. Failures: INV-2024-2215 (ledger mismatch after regen), INV-2024-2219 (duplicate invoice id collision).
tess (Finance): Which customers for failures?
devin (Billing Eng): INV-2024-2215 -> NimbusCo; INV-2024-2219 -> Solstice Labs. For NimbusCo I see tax records with overlapping tax jurisdiction entries (EU & UK) from tax-provider callback. For Solstice Labs the duplicate id is because previous retry wrote invoice with a trailing '-1' and our idempotency check missed it.
nana (Revenue Ops): Please prepare credit notes and apology email. Add one-time goodwill credit of $100 for affected accounts.
raj (Support): I'll send the draft message and include a note that refunds/credits will appear within 5-7 business days.
devin (Billing Eng): For the two regen failures, I'll escalate to infra and tax provider. Also adding stricter validation to invoice finalizer so total == sum(lines)+taxes before writing final invoice. If mismatch, fail safe -> do not emit PDF and escalate.
audit-bot: Change recorded: finalizer now validates totals at ts=2145681560.
tess (Finance): Thanks. Please add a daily reconcile job for the next week to verify no further duplicates. Also capture webhook payloads for 48h.
devin (Billing Eng): Will do. I'll upload affected invoice checksums and a list of reissued invoice IDs when complete.
audit-bot: Credit notes queued for 7 accounts at ts=2145681650.
tess (Finance): Filing ticket and tagging Legal for SLA review. Closing internal loop once credits processed.
raj (Support): Customer messages queued. Will update thread when refunds issued. :white_check_mark:
